_comment: TLS certificate expiry monitoring. Copy to config/cert_targets.json and point at real targets -- this collector is skipped entirely if that file doesn't exist. Certificate TRUST is deliberately not checked (no hostname/CA validation) -- only expiry, so this works against self-signed/internal-CA certs a LAN practice-management server is likely to use. Needs the openssl CLI on PATH. Only list a host here if it actually serves TLS -- this project's own local Grafana runs plain HTTP by default (no cert to check), which is a real, correctly-isolated per-target failure if listed here, not a bug.

hosts._note: checks the cert actually being served right now over a live TLS handshake -- replace with a real HTTPS-serving host on your network
hosts.name: practice-mgmt-portal

files._note: checks a local PEM cert file directly, without needing network reachability to the service
files.name: internal-ca-cert
